body:
We currently have this structure:

* V51.2 OAuth Authorization Server
* V51.3 OAuth Client
* V51.4 OAuth Resource Server
* V51.5 OIDC Client
* V51.5 OIDC OpenID Provider

I find it weird that the ordering is not the same for OAuth and OIDC :

* OAuth AS then OAuth client
* but OIDC client then OIDC OP (=AS)

could we move things around to keep the ordering more consistent?

comments.body: We can move things around, propose order.

I would suggest something like:

* V51.1 OAuth Client
* V51.2 OAuth Resource Server
* V51.3 OAuth Authorization Server
* V51.4 OIDC Client
* V51.5 OIDC OpenID Provider

Changes:

* Move client considerations first as we intent to have to check it for more applications
* Consistent order for OAuth part and OIDC part

Nitpick: "OIDC OpenID Provider" is somewhat redundant as it means "OpenID Connect OpenID Provider". Should we have "OpenID Provider (OIDC)" instead?

V51.1 OAuth Client as the first one? At the moment we have 1st "V51.1 Generic OAuth and OIDC security" as the first one, and we have PR to add "V51.7 Consent Management" as the last one.

So please add those 2 also to your proposal.
Oh yes sorry I forgot the first one :)

Proposition:

* V51.1 Generic OAuth and OIDC security
* V51.2 OAuth Client
* V51.3 OAuth Resource Server
* V51.4 OAuth Authorization Server
* V51.5 OIDC Client
* V51.6 OIDC OpenID Provider
* V51.7 Consent Management
